permissions.hrm.expense_claims.create: Make, change, submit and cancel expense claims
permissions.hrm.expense_claims.decide: Accept or reduce the lines of an expense claim waiting for your approval
errors.hrm.expense.amount_positive: The amount must be more than zero.
errors.hrm.expense.currency_invalid: Give the currency as three capital letters, for example USD.
errors.hrm.expense.quantity_required: Give the number of days or kilometres for this category.
errors.hrm.expense.quantity_positive: The number of days or kilometres must be more than zero.
errors.hrm.expense.reimburse_via_invalid: Choose payroll or a separate payment.
errors.hrm.expense.too_many_lines: A claim can have at most 100 lines. Make a second claim.
errors.hrm.expense.date_required: Give the date of the expense.
errors.hrm.expense.approved_out_of_range: The approved amount cannot be below zero or above the claimed amount.
errors.hrm.expense.reason_required: Give a reason when you approve less than was claimed.
errors.hrm.expense.not_draft: Only a draft claim can be changed, submitted or cancelled.
errors.hrm.expense.no_lines: Add at least one line before you submit the claim.
errors.hrm.expense.no_rate: There is no exchange rate for this currency on or before the expense date. Ask HR to add one.
errors.hrm.expense.no_currency: Your claim currency cannot be found: you are in no pay group and the company has no base currency. Ask HR.
errors.hrm.expense.category_unknown: This expense category does not exist or is switched off.
errors.hrm.expense.receipt_unknown: This receipt file does not belong to this claim. Upload it to the claim first.
errors.hrm.expense.blocked_by_flags: The claim cannot be submitted: a line breaks a rule of its category. Correct the flagged lines.
errors.hrm.expense.no_component: A category of this claim has no reimbursement component, so it cannot be paid through payroll. Ask HR, or choose a separate payment.
errors.hrm.expense.mixed_components: The categories of this claim are paid through different payroll components. Split the claim, or choose a separate payment.
errors.hrm.expense.component_not_allowed: The reimbursement component of this category cannot take a one-time amount. Ask HR.
errors.hrm.expense.employment_closed: This employment is not current, so no claim can be made for it.
errors.hrm.expense.use_withdraw: A claim that was sent for approval is withdrawn from its approval request.
errors.hrm.expense.not_waiting: This claim is not waiting for a decision.
errors.hrm.expense.not_approver: You cannot decide a claim that is yours or that was made for you.
errors.hrm.expense.not_found: The expense claim was not found.
errors.hrm.expense.no_pay_group: The employee is in no pay group today, so the claim cannot be paid through payroll. Set the pay group, then approve again.
errors.hrm.expense.no_open_period: The employee's pay group has no open pay period. Generate the pay calendar, then approve again.
errors.hrm.expense.currency_mismatch: The pay group's currency is no longer the currency of the claim. Return the claim so it can be made again.
errors.hrm.expense.component_gone: The reimbursement component of the claim is no longer usable. Ask HR, then approve again.
